chapter.verse: Hih in Adam’ suan-le-khakte’ tangthute ahi hi. Pasian in mi a piansakin, amah tawh a kisunin a bawl hi.
Amah in pasal leh numei piangsak hi, amaute a kipian’ sak khit ciangin amah in amaute Mi ci a, thupha a pia hi.
Adam kum za leh kum sawmthum a nuntak khit ciangin, ama' lim tawh a kibang, amah a sun tapa khat’ pa suak a, amah pen Seth ci-in a min phuak hi.
Seth a suah khit cianga Adam’ khan’ sung in kum zagiat ahi hi; amah in tapa leh tanu dang nei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Adam’ nuntak khan sung teng in kum zakua leh kum sawmthum ahi hi; tua ciangin amah si hi.
Seth kum za leh kum nga a nuntak khit ciangin Enosh kici tapa khat nei hi.
Enosh a suah khit ciangin Seth kum zagiat leh kum sagih nungta a, tapa leh tanu dang nei lai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Seth’ khan sung teng in kum zakua leh kum sawm-le-nih ahi hi; tua ciangin amah si hi.
Enosh kum sawmkua a nuntak khit ciangin, amah in Kenan kici tapa khat nei hi.
Kenan a suah khit ciangin Enosh kum zagiat leh kum sawm-le-nga nungta hi; tapa leh tanu dang nei lai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Enosh’ khan’ sung teng in kum zakua leh kum nga ahi hi; tua ciangin amah si hi.
Kenan kum sawmsagih a nuntak khit ciangin, Mahalalel kici tapa khat nei hi.
Mahalalel’ suah khit ciangin Kenan kum zagiat leh kum sawmli nungta a, tapa leh tanu dang nei lai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kenan’ khan sung teng in kum zakua leh kum sawm ahi hi; tua ciangin amah si hi.
Mahalalel kum sawmguk-le-nga a nuntak khit ciangin Jared kici tapa khat nei hi.
Jared’ suah khit ciangin Mahalelel kum zagiat leh kum sawmthum nungta a, tapa leh tanu dang nei lai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Mahalalel’ khan’ sung teng in kum zagiat leh kum sawmkua-le-nga ahi hi; tua ciangin amah si hi.
Jared kum za leh kum sawmguk-le-nih a nuntak khit ciangin Enok kici tapa khat nei hi.
Enok’ suah khit ciangin Jared kum zagiat nungta a, tapa leh tanu dang nei lai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Jared’ khan’ sung teng in kum zakua leh kum sawmguk-le-nih ahi hi; tua ciangin amah si hi.
Enok kum sawmguk-le-nga a nuntak khit ciangin, Methuselah kici tapa khat nei hi.
Methuselah’ suah khit ciangin Enok in kum zathum sung Pasian tawh lam paikhawm a, tapa leh tanu dang nei lai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Enok’ khan’ sung teng in kum zathum leh kum sawmguk-le-nga ahi hi.
Enok in Pasian tawh lam paikhawm hi; Enok kimu nawn lo hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in amah la hi.
Methuselah kum za leh kum sawmgiat-le-sagih a nuntak khit ciangin Lamek kici tapa khat nei hi.
Lamek’ suah khit ciangin Methuselah kum zasagih leh kum sawmgiat-le-nih nungta a, tapa leh tanu dang nei lai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Methuselah’ khan’ sung teng in kum za kua leh kum sawmguk-le-kua ahi hi; tua ciangin amah si hi.
Lamek kum za leh kum sawmgiat-le-nih a nuntak khit ciangin, tapa khat nei a,
ama min Noah phuakin, “ Topa in a ciamsiatsa leitang panin hihpa in i nasepna leh i gimnate panin eite hong khahkhia ding hi,” ci hi.
Noah’ suah khit ciangin Lamek kum zanga leh kum sawmkua-le-nga nungta a, tapa leh tanu dang nei lai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Lamek’ khan’ sung teng in kum za sagih leh kum sawmsagih-le-sagih ahi hi; tua ciangin amah si hi.
Noah kum za nga a phak khit ciangin, amah in Shem, Ham, leh Jafeth-te, tapa thum nei hi.
